title: 2022 CODATA: Josephson constant is 483 597.848 4... × 10^9
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks Josephson constant as exact: 483 597.848 4...
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks Josephson constant as exact: 483 597.848 4... × 10^9 Hz V^-1. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. The Josephson constant is the frequency-to-voltage ratio used in quantum voltage standards. The 2022 listing marks it exact and prints an ellipsis.
